description:
ScoreKeeper keeps game night moving. Set up a table in seconds, add your crew, and score every round without passing around a notes app or doing score math by hand.

Choose from Scoreboard, Phase 10, or What's for Dinner. Reuse saved players, undo the last round, and use built-in timer, dice, and starter tools when the table needs them.

When the game is over, ScoreKeeper saves the final scores, game history, player stats, and head-to-head results so every game night becomes part of your record.

Your first 25 games are free. A one-time purchase unlocks unlimited games with no subscription.
promotionalText: Set up faster, score every round, and keep the table moving.
whatsNew: A polished clubhouse scorecard experience for game night, with faster setup, clearer scoring, and smoother review and unlock flows.
